---
request: Compare these vendors on price for a team of 15 people.
material: e09.material/price-list.txt
---
## Verdict

**Kelp** costs least for a team of 15, at **$165 per month**. Its 10-seat minimum sits below the team size, so all 15 seats are billed at the list rate of $11 — no padding. Fennel HQ is the next option at $360/month, and Acme Desk is the most expensive at $680/month despite having the middle per-seat price, because its 40-seat minimum forces payment for 25 seats the team does not use.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Acme Desk | $17 | 40 |
| Fennel HQ | $24 | 1 |
| Kelp | $11 | 10 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 15 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Acme Desk:** minimum 40 > 15, so 40 seats paid. 40 × $17 = **$680/month**
- **Fennel HQ:** minimum 1 < 15, so 15 seats paid. 15 × $24 = **$360/month**
- **Kelp:** minimum 10 < 15, so 15 seats paid. 15 × $11 = **$165/month**

Effective per-seat cost for the 15 people actually working: Kelp $11.00, Fennel HQ $24.00, Acme Desk $45.33 ($680 ÷ 15).

## Risks

Kelp's advantage holds only while the team stays at or above 10 people; below that, the 10-seat floor raises the effective rate. Acme Desk's $680 is fixed until headcount reaches 40, so it only becomes competitive on a per-seat basis at scale — at 40 seats it is $17/seat versus Kelp's $11, so it does not overtake Kelp at any size on list price alone. All figures are list prices billed monthly; annual commitments, discounts, feature tiers, support levels, and usage overages are not in the price list and could change the ranking. Minimums may also be contractual floors that persist after a team shrinks.
